articles.title: Djokovic Battles Back to Beat Zverev at the China Open
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic came from a set down to beat Alexander Zverev and reach the China Open semi-finals.

articles.title: Shakira's Madrid Concert Sets an Amazon Music Livestream Record
articles.summary: Shakira's October 3 Madrid show, with surprise guest Dua Lipa, became the most-viewed livestream by a female artist on Amazon Music.

articles.title: Daniel Radcliffe and the Art of Playing a "Weird Little Guy"
articles.summary: A writer recommends Daniel Radcliffe's film "Swiss Army Man" on Netflix as an example of his post-Harry Potter career of unusual roles.
